admission.justification: Reverses eager 0-turn held-seat creation (MIK-R100 rule 2) after live Hermes zombie-process disproof and constrains every future seat reader, opener, retirement, and closing-archive path.

alternatives.option: Adopt Option C (BUG-R58@v2): reserve held Reviewer and Curator seats on disk with status='held', hostAgentExists=false, execution={}, pre-minted agentId, handover files on disk, and stored replayRequest without calling host agent-create during role_start_set; defer host agent creation and BUG-R51 binding confirmation until the first addressed role_message opens the seat (keeping legacy mode='open-held' for pre-existing pre-created held receipts).
alternatives.reason: Eliminates 0-turn Hermes zombie MCP server leaks and avoids unnecessary host creation while preserving pre-minted seat identity, handover custody, and BUG-R51 exclusive binding confirmation at actual open time.

alternatives.option: Keep eager 0-turn host creation on role_start_set (MIK-R100 rule 2 / BUG-R58@v1) and repair only BUG-R51 retry response propagation.
alternatives.reason: Disproved by live Rule 1 Hermes measurement: eager 0-turn host creation leaks zombie agents-remember-task processes on archive before first turn and triggers unnecessary host creation and binding-confirmation failures for unused held seats.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Paseo and all supported harnesses guarantee deterministic zero-leak server teardown on 0-turn agent-create/archive AND a product requirement demands host-visible idle held seats before first message.

alternatives.option: Skip BUG-R51 binding confirmation for held seats during role_start_set while still eagerly creating host agents.
alternatives.reason: Still creates unused host agents with leaked 0-turn MCP processes on Hermes and weakens exclusive seat-binding protection.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Host runtimes natively isolate and garbage-collect per-agent MCP processes without pre-turn leaks.

consequences: Modifies MIK-R100 rule 2: reserved held seats exist on disk (hostAgentExists=false, execution={}) with zero host calls until first role_message creates and opens them.
Every seat reader, occupancy check, provider-limit guard, archive/preview pass, and retirement path must recognize uncreated deferred held seats without querying the host.

Standing docs describing held seats as existing on the host before first message (docs/tool-details.md, package_data copy, docs/concepts.md, docs/reference/role-capsules.md) carry open deferrals until their next doc edit.
context: BUG-R58@v2 / D1045: Under MIK-R100 rule 2, role_start_set eagerly created held Reviewer and Curator agents on Paseo with zero turns. Live measurement on Paseo 0.16.2 showed Hermes spawns MCP servers eagerly during 0-turn agent-create and never cleans them up when archived before a first turn, leaking zombie agents-remember-task processes that later collide with BUG-R51 seat-binding confirmation and waste host resources when held seats never open.
decider: Developer D1045 (BUG-R58@v2), verified by Reviewer R2 and Worker W2 Evidence 1 on Paseo 0.16.2.
